import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (box plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by 4K capability
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
colors = ['#ff7f0e' if x == 1 else '#1f77b4' for x in df['has_video_4k']]
ax2.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], alpha=0.5, c=colors, s=20)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price\n(4K Capability)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#ff7f0e', label='4K Video'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#1f77b4', label='No 4K')]
ax2.legend(handles=legend_elements, fontsize=8)

# 3. Camera evolution over time
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
year_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['megapixels'], 
                 color='#2ca02c', marker='o', linewidth=2, label='Avg Megapixels')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['price_usd'], 
                      color='#d62728', marker='s', linewidth=2, label='Avg Price')
ax3.set_title('Camera Technology Evolution Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=10, color='#2ca02c')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10, color='#d62728')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2ca02c')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#d62728')
lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

# 4. Brand distribution (top 8)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
ax4.barh(range(len(brand_counts)), brand_counts.values, color='steelblue')
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(brand_counts)))
ax4.set_yticklabels(brand_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_title('Top 8 Camera Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Number of Models', fontsize=10)
ax4.invert_yaxis()

# 5. Body type vs sensor type heatmap
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
body_sensor_crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['body_type'], df['sensor_type'])
sns.heatmap(body_sensor_crosstab, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax5, cbar_kws={'label': 'Count'})
ax5.set_title('Body Type vs Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Weight vs Price by body type
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()[:4]  # Top 4 body types
for body in body_types:
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax6.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], 
               label=body, alpha=0.6, s=25)
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price\nby Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
